title: Binding Homeowners Insurance Ahead of Closing
content:
Homeowners Insurance from Calloway Insurance Agency is usually bound before the home closes, so that the lender has proof of hazard insurance. The binding rule:

> A quote is bound when the insured accepts it and the first installment (or the full premium on the annual plan) is received; the binder is sent to the lender. The binder should be issued at least the program's binder lead time in calendar days before the purchase agreement's scheduled closing date. Coverage becomes effective on the actual closing date, and if the closing date moves the effective date moves with it. A binder is issued only while the policy status is quoted.

## The parts of the rule

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| When a quote becomes bound | The insured accepts the quote and the first installment is received; on the annual plan, the full premium is received |
| Who receives the binder | The lender |
| Policy status for issuing a binder | Quoted, and only quoted |
| Timing of the binder | Should be issued at least the program's binder lead time, in calendar days, before the scheduled closing date on the Home Purchase Agreement |
| When coverage begins | The actual closing date |
| Effect of a moved closing date | The effective date moves with it |

## Dates on the policy

A quote carries the home's scheduled closing date as its effective date and an expiration date one year after the effective date. When the home closes, the effective date is the actual closing date and the policy passes from bound to in force on that date. If the closing does not happen, the binder is cancelled flat.

## Points of judgement

**Acceptance alone.** A quote the insured has accepted but on which the first installment (or, on the annual plan, the full premium) has not been received is not yet bound.

**Status.** A binder is issued on a policy in status quoted. A policy already in status bound, in force, cancelled or non-renewed is not in status quoted, and no binder is issued on it.

**Lead time, on abstract days.** Take a scheduled closing date and a program binder lead time of N calendar days. A binder issued N calendar days before the scheduled closing date, or earlier, meets the lead time. A binder issued fewer than N calendar days before the scheduled closing date does not.

**Closing moved (hypothetical dates).** A HomeShield policy quoted with a scheduled closing date of the 15th, whose closing then moves to the 29th of the same month, takes the 29th as its effective date, and coverage begins on the 29th.
